title: Left exact functors preserve cohomology when cycles and boundaries are injective
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ and $\mathcal B$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian], let $C^\bullet$ be a bounded-below complex in $\mathcal A$, and define $Z^q(C)=\ker(d_C^q)$, $B^q(C)=\operatorname{im}(d_C^{q-1})$, and $H^q(C)=Z^q(C)/B^q(C)$. Suppose every $Z^q(C)$ and $B^q(C)$ is injective [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. For every left exact additive functor $G:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ [def-sp-left-exact-additive], the canonical comparison induced by the maps on cycles and quotients is an isomorphism $H^q(G(C^\bullet))\cong G(H^q(C^\bullet))$ for every $q$.
